distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2024) provides the first mainland China record from Yunnan; Hong Kong and Taiwan evidence remains independently supported. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Lin et al. (2024) reports no host; prior genus-level hosts are retained.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus mesuae (Eggers, 1930).
